She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing naturally with her hands to emphasize her points about skincare routines and the challenges of aging skin. (2) The video cuts to a series of close-up photos showing her face with visible red skin blemishes and acne scars, contrasting with her current appearance. (3) Wearing a black cat-ear headband, she is shown in a bright indoor setting carefully applying the serum to her face with her fingers.
